did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. A shop had an accepted pre-order for a box of Seclo that was waiting for the goods. The owner opened the pre-orders page, wrote why it did not come, and pressed "Did not come, cancel". The shop opened its pre-orders page.

checks.text: The owner's card has a reason box ("Why it did not come, the buyer will read it") and the button "Did not come, cancel"
The shop gets a sorry note at the top of its pre-orders: "Sorry, your pre-order for Seclo 20 mg could not be supplied: The company has not sent it this month."
The pre-order turns to Cancelled in the shop's list, so nothing hangs

notes: Done by hand in the live browser, not by a script.

shots.caption: The owner: the reason and "Did not come, cancel"
The shop sees the sorry note and the pre-order Cancelled
